'''''The Agony of Tarkin''''' was an [[Opera/Legends|opera]] performed by the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Imperial Opera Company]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|15|''Agony of Tarkin, The''}}</ref> aboard the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="Film IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Death Star Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]</ref> The opera was performed<ref name="Emperor's Hand 2" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Emperor's Hand 2" /> around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="Date">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 2|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 2]] dates itself to 4 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|IV}}. Since the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the film to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]/[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], ''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 2 must take place around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]</ref> and the opera's venue allowed attendees in balcony seats to view close-up shots of the performance via [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]]. The production used a huge stage, glowing in [[Color/Legends|pink]] light, and a stellar backdrop.<ref name="Emperor's Hand 2" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] treated herself to a showing of ''The Agony of Tarkin'' during a vacation from her duties. However, she felt that at times the spectators were more amusing than the theatre. After the opera's conclusion, Jade attended a reception along with other guests to the opera, many of whom were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="Emperor's Hand 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The Agony of Tarkin'' first appeared in the [[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 2|second issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and [[Michael A. Stackpole]],<ref name="Emperor's Hand 2" /> and published in [[September 2]], [[1998]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/97-640/Star-Wars-Mara-Jade---By-The-Emperors-Hand-2-of-6|text=Star Wars: Mara Jade - By The Emperor's Hand #2 (of 6)}}</ref> In the [[2013]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', developed by [[Disney Mobile]], the opera could be performed at the "Galaxies Opera" recreation level on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. In the game, the opera lasted two hours and cost 1,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="TDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
